scope: AC-INT-04: same initiative under broad and separated review configurations
evidence: The same full native initiative is parametrized across one broad authenticated agent with reviewer separation off and a separate independent reviewer with enforce. Both variants run Draft→review→approved→validated→in_progress→Done, including lint, Spec validation/evaluation, task implementation report/review, real signed HTTP assertion, Test Card report and final Spec completion.

Separate review opens another MCP client and authenticates independent identity for each of the three review operations. Stored Spec reviewer/evaluator and task reviewer match that identity; task conclusions, implementation/progress/test records and external lint ownership remain solo.

Both configurations preserve original assessments and proof payloads. Both refuse Spec completion until the required test evidence exists. The late-link variant also refuses a previously signed receipt after its criterion scope changes.

Reused current-pair handoff witnesses check real least-authority grants: reviewer cannot submit executor batch capture, executor cannot self-review even with submit under enforce, and exact actor attribution/history survive reject/rework.
Reused classification suite checks whole-batch permissions, actor-bound replay and immutable policy, with no partial write when any required authority is denied.

tests.reused: 10 review authority,4 frontend and56 classification cases already recorded; hashes verified, not reexecuted/recounted

limits: Full-flow reviewer receives the broad preset to isolate identity separation; restricted-grant behavior is separately proven by the handoff suite.
Credential extraction is supplied in-process to the real authenticator and SQL Agent/AgentBoard grants. Not an installed network authentication E2E.

External implementation receipt and initial context are fixture inputs. HTTP assertion execution/signature/admission are real in-process. Explicit cognitive skip, impact off and declared resource inapplicability bound the initiative.
No product/SPA changes; only test parametrization and evidence. Main87 closure applicable with all eight budgets zero. No migration or promotion.
